title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
description: Empirically establishes that language model loss follows a power law with respect to model parameters, dataset size, and compute — each independently. Shows that for a fixed compute budget, the optimal strategy is to scale parameters and data proportionally. This paper justified the investment in GPT-3 and every large model since.
authors: Kaplan, McCandlish, Henighan, Brown, Chess, Child, Gray, Radford, Wu, Amodei (OpenAI)
